user.title: Hunter Douglas Platinum Gateway
user.description: Enter the IP address of your Platinum gateway (shown in the Platinum App). Give it a fixed IP in your router first.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the gateway on that address. Close the Platinum App on your phone (the gateway only handles one connection at a time) and try again.

abort.already_configured: This gateway is already set up.

data.vane_shades: Shades with vanes (add a vane control)
data.separate_vane_entities: Create a separate 'Vanes' slider per shade

data_description.vane_feature: 07 for Platinum vane shades. Shades that report this code get vanes automatically.
data_description.invert_middle_rail: Turn on if 'open' moves the middle rail the wrong way.
data_description.expose_unknown_features: Shows a 'Feature NN' cover for every feature code the gateway reports that isn't the bottom rail, middle rail or configured vane code.
data_description.tdbu_shades: Tick blinds that open from the top. Only needed if the gateway doesn't mark them as top-down/bottom-up itself.
data_description.vane_shades: Tick blinds with vanes that didn't get a vane control automatically.
data_description.separate_vane_entities: Recommended: shows vanes as their own slider in any dashboard card. The tilt control on the main shade stays as well.

error.invalid_feature: Enter a number from 0 to 99, or leave empty.

set_feature.name: Set shade feature
set_feature.description: Send a raw position to any feature of a shade. Useful for testing vane or rail codes.

shade_id.name: Shade ID
shade_id.description: Two-digit shade number from the gateway (see the shade's attributes).

feature.name: Feature code
feature.description: 04 = bottom rail, 18 = middle rail, others discovered from the gateway.

config_entry_id.name: Gateway
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with more than one gateway.

refresh.name: Refresh and dump
refresh.description: Re-read the gateway and return rooms, shades, reported feature codes and the raw $dat lines.

config_entry_id.name: Gateway
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with more than one gateway.
